name: Exact Encoding of Bounded Cornerless Lifts
statement: For a fixed Boolean class $B$, a new coordinate $z$, and an integer $N$, the formula $L_{B,N}$ is satisfiable exactly when $B$ has a cornerless ample lift $Y\subseteq B\times\{0,1\}$ of order at most $N$, with all old coordinates and $z$ active and with projection along $z$ equal to $B$.
proof: Restricting the general facet-cube encoding to vertices and cubes inside $B\times\{0,1\}$ preserves exactness because every facet cube of a lift lies there. Requiring at least one copy of every $b\in B$ makes the projection contain $B$, while the ambient restriction gives the reverse inclusion. A totalizer imposes the order bound, and the remaining clauses retain exact ampleness, activity, and cornerlessness.
